newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade $66, moderate - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade $66, moderate - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower than late last week. Inquiry good, demand fair.

Sales confirmed on 15,300 slaughter steers and 11,300 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 30,500 head confirmed including 3,400 head or about 11 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1275 lbs 66.00; few Select with end Choice 1050-1225 lbs 65.50.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 66.00; few Select with end Choice 65.50; few mixed Commercial to Choice heifers and heiferettes 1050-1125 lbs 65.00, pen including cows 1250 lbs 64.00.
Confirmed - 26,600 last week - none last year - 17,100
Wk to date - 30,500 last week - 5,200 last year - 27,800
